university_basketball: basketball_match: win_loss_records (ACC_Regular_Season, ACC_Home, ACC_Road, All_Games, All_Home, All_Road, All_Neutral). university_rank: City/state are geographic levels; reputation/research/citation and total points are score alternatives. Rank is ordinal and excluded from points.
vehicle_driver: Speed, power, build year and production quantity have incompatible units; driver citizenship and racing series are distinct categories.
vehicle_rent: Combined/city/highway fuel-economy rates measure the same quantity. Per-25-mile and annual fuel cost have different reference intervals and remain separate.
video_game: Game title/franchise/developer and player name/college/position name different entity types; rank and sales have no same-table comparable measures.
voter_1: State and contestant fields are relationships/keys; phone numbers are identifiers and created is an isolated timestamp.
voter_2: Student name parts are valid alternatives; office-specific votes are foreign keys to students and excluded despite useful role similarity.
warehouse_1: Warehouses and boxes each offer one capacity/value measure and one location/contents label; no safe same-table peers.
wedding: No safe peers: male/female wedding roles are foreign keys, while church name/organizer/continuation labels refer to different things.
wine_1: appellations: geographic_levels (County, State, Area). Groups express related alternatives; identifiers and unrelated physical units excluded.
workshop_paper: No safe same-table peers: venue, workshop name, submission author/college, score and acceptance result are distinct roles or measures.
world_1: Current/previous GNP share monetary units, official/local names share an entity, and continent/region are geographic levels. Exclude country codes, capital IDs and different demographic/economic units.
wrestler: No safe peers: reign number and days held use distinct units; wrestler/team/eliminator/move/time refer to different entity classes or concepts.
wta_1: players: player_name_components (first_name, last_name); matches: opponent_age (loser_age, winner_age), opponent_entry (loser_entry, winner_entry), opponent_hand (loser_hand, winner_hand), opponent_ht (loser_ht, winner_ht), opponent_ioc (loser_ioc, winner_ioc), opponent_name (loser_name, winner_name), opponent_rank (loser_rank, winner_rank), opponent_rank_points (loser_rank_points, winner_rank_points), opponent_seed (loser_seed, winner_seed). Groups express related alternatives; identifiers and unrelated physical units excluded.
yelp: Business city/state and latitude/longitude are geographic alternatives. Rating, review counts, likes and year/month have different scales; user/business codes are identifiers.
